why: Only the store-page shim is vendored: it installs chrome.webstorePrivate/chrome.management so the Chrome Web Store renders 'Add to Chrome'. The package's main-process half is NOT used (no CRX signature verification, prefix origin check, unvalidated uninstall path, 3-part version compare); src/main/browser/extensions/webstore.ts owns every IPC handler. The npm dependency is not added.
edits: Header comment naming the source, license and this file.
DEBUG = false: upstream hard-codes true and console.debug's install details into the store page console.
Gate changed from location.href.startsWith('https://chromewebstore.google.com') to location.origin === 'https://chromewebstore.google.com' && window === window.top (exact origin, top frame only).
